Inverter shuts down at 40% battery

volt_ua 1 Nov 2026, 21:14

My hybrid inverter switches the house to the grid when the battery reaches 40%, even though I set the cut-off to 20% in the app. The grid was down last night, so we lost power for two hours, with half the battery left.

Firmware is 2.31, battery is a 10 kWh LiFePO4 pack. Has anyone seen this?

kateryna_s 1 Nov 2026, 22:03

I set the cut-off to 20% in the app

There are two settings, and the app only shows one of them. The "battery low" value in the app is for grid-tied mode; off-grid uses a separate shutdown value, which on 2.31 defaults to 40%. You have to change it on the inverter's own screen, under Battery → Shutdown.

volt_ua 2 Nov 2026, 08:40

That was it, thank you! I set Shutdown to 15% and Restart to 25%. Steps, for anyone else:

  1. Hold the Enter button for three seconds.
  2. Go to Battery, then Shutdown.
  3. Set the value and press Enter again.

Marking this as solved.
